# Findings: RS-01 support-plan-offers

## Answer
Two studios publish monthly support plans: one with 4 hours for $480 a month [F-01], one from $350 a month with 3 hours [F-02], both as published on 2026-10-18. A paid directory says most studios charge $300 to $600 a month, but it is LOW [F-03].

## Findings

### F-01
- claim: Northpine Automation publishes a care plan of 4 hours a month for $480 a month, as published on 2026-10-18.
- level: HIGH
- basis: states
- sources: S-01 (https://northpine.example.com/services/support, retrieved 2026-10-18, primary)
- conflicts: none
- watch: no
- run: R-1

### F-02
- claim: Brightloop Studio publishes support from $350 a month with 3 hours included, as published on 2026-10-18.
- level: HIGH
- basis: states
- sources: S-02 (https://brightloop.example.org/pricing, retrieved 2026-10-18, primary)
- conflicts: none
- watch: no
- run: R-1

### F-03
- claim: A paid studio directory says most studios it lists charge $300 to $600 a month for support.
- level: LOW
- basis: states
- sources: S-03 (https://directory.example.net/automation-studios, retrieved 2026-10-18, secondary)
- conflicts: none
- watch: no
- run: R-1

none

## Gaps
- Cobaltworks' published plan: its page redirected to an unencrypted address and was not opened (P-04) — would settle it: the same page at an https address, or their sales team.
